profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Exact Sciences
profile.summary:
A Software Engineer known to automate things he considers tedious in his day-to-day work and use it as an excuse to learn something new in the process.

Lead Software Engineer of the Blood "LIS" (LIMS) supporting the Exact Sciences Cancerguard® test.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer of the Blood "LIS" (LIMS) supporting the Exact Sciences Cancerguard® test.
- Key decision maker in all application enhancements and integrations
- Leading a team of 10+ engineers in a Scrumban environment
- Experience with Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, GitLab Duo, Intellij AI Assistant
- Involved in interviewing for engineering and product roles

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer of the Blood "LIS" (LIMS) supporting the Exact Sciences Cancerguard® test.
- Key decision maker in all application enhancements and integrations
- Leading a team of 4+ engineers in a Scrumban environment

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Engineer on the Liquid Biopsy "LIS" (LIMS) from Aug 2021 to Dec 2022, followed by starting up the Blood "LIS" (LIMS) supporting then up-and-coming Cancerguard®test.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Full stack software developer on the flagship OnCore product. Leveraging PL/SQL, JPA, Java, JSTL, and JavaScript across multiple applications utilizing Gitlab pipelines and automated Jenkins deployments. Working closely with others on a small, Agile team to identify and remove bugs as well as refine acceptance criteria for the design and implementation of new features. Coordinating with cross-functional teams to gather customer requirements for both external and internal software projects.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Obtained first experiences in a real-world SDLC process. Broadened knowledge of Java EE web application development. Utilized Burp Suite to find and remove Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and SQL injection vulnerabilities. Collaborated with other interns to develop tools to assist in day-to-day work.

positions.title: General Laborer
positions.description: The primary focus for this business is the sale, maintenance, and installation of vehicle lifts in both public and private settings. My work included taking inventory, operation of heavy machinery, assembly of the vehicle lifts, and general building and grounds maintenance.

positions.title: Part-Time Package Handler
positions.description: Summer work involving the unloading of full sized semi-trailers and sorting of packages.

positions.title: IT Assistant
positions.description: I provided short term summer help by building and cataloging computer workstations, as well as updating old ones.

positions.title: Part-Time Package Handler
positions.description: Over the summer I handled the unloading of full sized semi-trailers, sorting of over-sized packages, and sorting of small packages.

organizations.name: Cub Scouts and Boy Scouts of America
